source: NYSED Office of the Professions; NY Education Law 6605-b, 6606, 6608; 2026 eMedNY dental manual
rda_allowed_duties: impressions for space maintainers, ortho appliances, occlusal guards
unlicensed_assistant_allowed: chairside four-handed assisting while dentist is at chair

hygienist_cert_rules.local_anesthesia: restricted certificate required; dentist must remain in office and examine patient before dismissal
hygienist_cert_rules.nitrous: restricted certificate required; dentist must remain in office

medicaid_notes: fees are payment in full; members cannot be charged for canceled or missed appointments; prior approval for implants, ortho and some major work
